title: Fazcraft Modpack
description: The official modpack used on the Fazcraft server.
body:
The official modpack used by the Fazcraft multiplayer server.

This pack focuses on a fun Minecraft experience focusing on Fazcraft; including other modding behemoths such as Oh The Biomes We've Gone, a large collection of Yung's mods, Create, Create Aeronautics, and more!

Spawn is filled with plenty of users willing to offer you a helping hand to get you started. The spawn area is also themed after a fun carnival featuring Freddy and a few of his friends. Aside from that, enjoy a fun Survival experience being hunted by all of our favorite Fazbear characters!
